checks.label: /items_batch uses adapter-specific current write fields
checks.evidence: Expected quantity_to_sell_on_facebook, link, image_link, item_group_id and formatted price; legacy inventory/url/image_url/group fields must leave the write adapter.

checks.label: Zero-stock backorder maps to available for order
checks.evidence: Expected explicit availability value 'available for order'.

checks.label: Future sale is emitted with effective date range
checks.evidence: Expected future sale_price plus sale_price_effective_date; future start must not be discarded.

checks.label: No raw database productId in Meta content_ids
checks.evidence: Migrate all item event content_ids through the canonical Meta catalog identity builder.

checks.label: Server/public catalog identity sources are configured and parity-validated
checks.evidence: Expected a server-only parity validator and both environment variables.

checks.label: Graph API version policy has an upgrade/expiry gate
checks.evidence: Expected controlled version policy, warning/block dates and a CI/deploy gate.

checks.label: ProductVariant supports lifecycle, sale, availability and identifiers
checks.evidence: ProductVariant must carry independent lifecycle/sale/availability/identifier metadata.

checks.label: Non-essential tracking defaults to false
checks.evidence: Schema default must be false with an explicit historical backfill policy.

checks.label: Meta CAPI uses a database transactional outbox
checks.evidence: Expected outbox insertion in the same DB transaction as the business event.

checks.label: Meta retry schedule covers immediate, 1m, 5m, 15m and 1h
checks.evidence: Expected provider-specific durable retry schedule and DLQ classification.

checks.label: Shared CAPI web contract requires all website fields
checks.evidence: Required website fields must be mandatory in one canonical adapter contract.

checks.label: Canonical catalog item includes full presentation and merchandising fields
checks.evidence: Expected full canonical presentation fields before adapter serialization.

checks.label: Meta lifecycle statuses use Prisma enums
checks.evidence: Expected explicit enums for jobs, batches, events, leads, connections, webhooks and approvals.

checks.label: Catalog Diagnostics are persisted and exposed
checks.evidence: Expected per-item diagnostic ingestion, API and admin visibility.
